usage: The word 生炒骨 is a noun referring to a dish made from pork ribs cooked in a sweet and sour sauce.
You can use 生炒骨 when ordering food at a restaurant or when talking about favorite dishes.
In sentences, 生炒骨 functions as the object or subject, like any food noun.
You can combine 生炒骨 with quantifiers like 份 (fan6, 'portion') to specify the amount you want.
It is common to hear 生炒骨 paired with 饭 (faan6, 'rice') as a meal combination.
